correctness.rationale: The source generalized snake poset P(w) has one minimum and maximum, and rank n+2 measured in cover steps, verified in primary Definition 3.2 and printed p.5. The standard order polytope is cut out by coordinate walls with Euclidean unit normals and cover walls with normal length √2. For r=(2+(n+2)√2)^−1, c_p=r[1+√2ℓ(p)], where ℓ is longest cover-chain length from the minimum, has at least r clearance from each coordinate wall and from every cover wall; if p≺q then ℓ(q)≥ℓ(p)+1. Along a longest minimum-to-maximum saturated chain of n+2 cover edges, any inscribed ball of radius ρ consumes distances ≥ρ at each endpoint and ≥√2ρ at each edge, so 1≥(2+(n+2)√2)ρ. Both bounds coincide. Verified actual RESULT.md, source rank statement and helper verify.py reconstruction of snake words; no finite-word sampling is substituted for the all-n inequality.
